description: This file manages CLI session bindings, session IDs, and related utilities for a software project, including hashing, normalization, setting, clearing, and resolving session data.

methods.name: trimOptional
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string if defined, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: hashCliSessionText
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash of the provided session text after trimming.

methods.name: getCliSessionBinding
methods.description: Retrieves the CLI session binding for a given session entry and provider.

methods.name: getCliSessionId
methods.description: Gets the session ID for a given session entry and provider.

methods.name: setCliSessionId
methods.description: Sets the session ID for a given session entry and provider.

methods.name: setCliSessionBinding
methods.description: Sets the CLI session binding for a session entry and provider.

methods.name: clearCliSession
methods.description: Removes the CLI session binding and ID for a specific provider.

methods.name: clearAllCliSessions
methods.description: Clears all CLI session bindings and IDs from a session entry.

methods.name: resolveCliSessionReuse
methods.description: Resolves whether a CLI session can be reused based on current and stored binding data.
